headline: 14 killed as bus crashes into sand-laden truck in Natore
summary: At least 14 people died and over 20 others were injured in a head-on collision on the Pabna-Natore highway early today.
details: At least 14 people were killed and more than 20 injured in a head-on collision between a bus and a truck on the Pabna-Natore highway near Natore's Bonpara early today.
A Rajshahi-bound bus of RP Paribahan collided with a sand-laden truck around 4:00 am, according to Sub-Inspector Md Alamgir Hossain of the Bonpara Highway Police Station.
Police and firefighters rushed to the spot to conduct rescue operations after receiving information about the crash.
The injured have been admitted to Natore General Hospital, the Boraigram Upazila Health Complex, and other nearby hospitals.
Md Shariful Haque, superintendent of police in Natore, confirmed the death toll and stated that an investigation into the incident is underway.
A seven-member probe committee, headed by Additional District Magistrate Abul Hayat, has been formed to investigate the accident.
The collision disrupted vehicular movement on the Pabna-Rajshahi highway for some time.
caption:
14 dead and over 20 injured in a horrific head-on collision in Natore.

At least 14 people were killed and more than 20 injured in a head-on collision between a bus and a truck on the Pabna-Natore highway near Natore's Bonpara early today.

A Rajshahi-bound bus of RP Paribahan collided with a sand-laden truck around 4:00 am, according to Sub-Inspector Md Alamgir Hossain of the Bonpara Highway Police Station.

Police and firefighters rushed to the spot to conduct rescue operations after receiving information about the crash.

The injured have been admitted to Natore General Hospital, the Boraigram Upazila Health Complex, and other nearby hospitals.

Md Shariful Haque, superintendent of police in Natore, confirmed the death toll and stated that an investigation into the incident is underway.

A seven-member probe committee, headed by Additional District Magistrate Abul Hayat, has been formed to investigate the accident.

The collision disrupted vehicular movement on the Pabna-Rajshahi highway for some time.

headline_marked: PM [[visits Durga Puja mandaps in 3 districts]] on Mahanavami
headline: PM visits Durga Puja mandaps in 3 districts on Mahanavami
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman travels to Rangpur, Rajshahi, and Chattogram to greet devotees and visit puja venues.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived at Saidpur Airport in Rangpur on Tuesday morning to visit Durga Puja mandaps during the festival's Mahanavami.
He departed from Tejgaon Airport in Dhaka at 9:00 AM via a military aircraft, landing in Saidpur around 10:00 AM.
In Rangpur, the Prime Minister is scheduled to visit the Radha Govinda Temple and exchange greetings with devotees.
Following his visit to Rangpur, the Prime Minister will travel to Rajshahi, arriving at Shah Makhdum Airport at 1:15 PM to visit the local puja mandap.
His itinerary includes a stop at the Rajshahi Circuit House and attending a public meeting at Haji Muhammad Muhsin Government High School field at 3:00 PM.
Later, the afternoon, he will fly to Chattogram, arriving at Shah Amanat International Airport at 5:30 PM to visit the JM Sen Hall Rahmatganj puja mandap.
The Prime Minister is scheduled to return to Dhaka by 9:15 PM after completing his tour of the three divisions.
The tour is aimed at celebrating the Sharadiya Durga Puja festival with the people of different regions of the country.
caption:
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman is visiting Durga Puja mandaps across three districts today.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived at Saidpur Airport in Rangpur on Tuesday morning to visit Durga Puja mandaps during the festival's Mahanavami.

He departed from Tejgaon Airport in Dhaka at 9:00 AM via a military aircraft, landing in Saidpur around 10:00 AM.

In Rangpur, the Prime Minister is scheduled to visit the Radha Govinda Temple and exchange greetings with devotees.

Following his visit to Rangpur, the Prime Minister will travel to Rajshahi, arriving at Shah Makhdum Airport at 1:15 PM to visit the local puja mandap.

His itinerary includes a stop at the Rajshahi Circuit House and attending a public meeting at Haji Muhammad Muhsin Government High School field at 3:00 PM.

Later, the afternoon, he will fly to Chattogram, arriving at Shah Amanat International Airport at 5:30 PM to visit the JM Sen Hall Rahmatganj puja mandap.

The Prime Minister is scheduled to return to Dhaka by 9:15 PM after completing his tour of the three divisions.

The tour is aimed at celebrating the Sharadiya Durga Puja festival with the people of different regions of the country.
